meta.title: SUSI CEO cockpits
meta.description: Two cockpits side by side: the external orchestration cockpit (the standalone app the external harness runs) and susi's own native cockpit, served by susi harness cockpit. Each panel keeps its own URL in the browser.

panel.title: CEO cockpit
panel.offline: This cockpit is not answering at its URL. Start the external app (default http://localhost:8080/) or susi's own panel (susi harness cockpit … --port 9181), or point the field at wherever it runs.
